source: PRISMS-Plasticity paper (Yaghoobi et al., Comput. Mater. Sci. 169, 2019), Fig. 10
description: Deformed pole figures of polycrystalline Cu after 40% true strain in uniaxial compression. Initial texture input as RANDOM (per the Fig. 10 caption). Colour scale 0 to 2.5 MRD.
digitized_by: pixel/colorbar mapping of the rendered figure; values are approximate (+/- ~0.2 MRD)

100.pattern: four-fold ring of intensity at intermediate radius; depleted centre

110.pattern: strong central maximum = <110> compression fibre aligned with the compression axis; this is the primary target feature

overall: WEAK compression texture; median MRD ~0.5 across each figure; the single dominant feature is the {110} central compression fibre at ~2.3-2.5 MRD
match_priority: 1. {110} central maximum present at ~2.3-2.5 MRD (pattern + peak)
2. {100} and {111} central minima with mid-radius rings, peaks ~1.4-1.9
3. overall texture strength weak (no feature much above 2.5)
